build.buildCommand: pip install -r requirements.txt && cd app && npm install && NODE_OPTIONS='--max-old-space-size=4096' npm run build

deploy.startCommand: if [ "${FLOW_WORKER_ENABLED:-0}" = "1" ]; then exec python -m api.flow_worker_main; elif [ "${WORKER_ENABLED:-0}" = "1" ]; then exec python -m api.worker_main; else exec uvicorn api.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port $PORT --proxy-headers --forwarded-allow-ips='*' --timeout-graceful-shutdown 5; fi
